context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5.6B Correlation Cluster Engine fully verified. Key features: (1) Correlation matrix engine builds deterministic matrix from 15m candles with window=96, cache TTL=60s, (2) Cluster builder groups symbols with correlation>=0.75 threshold using connected component algorithm, (3) Cluster exposure calculator aggregates positions by cluster with direction detection (LONG/SHORT/NEUTRAL/MIXED), (4) Cluster risk governor evaluates exposure_limit=0.35, position_limit=3, direction_limit=0.85 and emits CLUSTER_RISK_LIMIT_HIT events, (5) Cluster order guard rejects trades that would exceed limit, reduces size near limit, (6) Cluster governance audit builds CLUSTER_CREATED/LIMIT_HIT/TRADE_REJECTED/UPDATED events, (7) Strategy governance endpoint includes cluster_risk_overlay array. Frontend page at /admin/futures/cluster-risk with data-testid=nav-admin-futures-cluster-risk-link for navigation. UI shows: summary cards (symbols/clusters/alerts/state), correlation heatmap table, cluster exposure bars, cluster risk alerts list, cluster position map.
